SELECT /* LGVATT20010.retrieveOrgList */ org.organization_id as code , org.org_name as name , org.parent_org_id , org.org_type ,( SELECT xmlagg(XMLELEMENT(x, '/', om.organization_id) ORDER BY LEVEL DESC).extract('//text()').getstringval() FROM org_master om START WITH om.organization_id = org.organization_id AND trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN trunc(om.org_start_date) AND trunc(NVL(om.org_end_date, SYSDATE)) CONNECT BY PRIOR om.parent_org_id = om.organization_id AND trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN trunc(om.org_start_date) AND trunc(NVL(om.org_end_date, SYSDATE)) ) AS org_id_path /* 조직의 상하위 구조로 정렬하기 위해 조직의 상위조직을 역으로 조회하여 구성한다. */ FROM ( SELECT om.organization_id , om.org_name_local AS org_name , om.parent_org_id , LPAD(om.org_type, 3, '0') AS org_type FROM emp_master em , org_master om WHERE em.employee_number = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.employeeNo} AND om.organization_id = em.organization_id UNION SELECT om.organization_id , om.org_name_local AS org_name , om.parent_org_id , LPAD(om.org_type, 3, '0') AS org_type FROM org_master om START WITH om.organization_id IN (SELECT om.organization_id FROM org_master om WHERE trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN trunc(om.org_start_date) AND trunc(NVL(om.org_end_date, SYSDATE)) AND om.org_manager_number = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.employeeNo} ) AND trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN trunc(om.org_start_date) AND trunc(NVL(om.org_end_date, SYSDATE)) CONNECT BY PRIOR om.organization_id = om.parent_org_id AND trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN trunc(om.org_start_date) AND trunc(NVL(om.org_end_date, SYSDATE))
UNION SELECT om.organization_id , om.org_name_local AS org_name , om.parent_org_id , LPAD(om.org_type, 3, '0') AS org_type FROM tb_att_contract_n tac , emp_master em , org_master om WHERE tac.time_attend_contact_user_id = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.employeeNo} AND em.assignment_category = 'LGD_OW' AND om.subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} AND om.subsidiary_code = em.subsidiary_code AND om.organization_id = em.organization_id AND om.organization_id = tac.organization_id AND om.subsidiary_code = tac.subsidiary_code
) org
WHERE org.org_type <= (SELECT code_data1_value FROM lgcom_common_code_c cc WHERE cc.code_type_code = 'LGVHR_ATT_COMMON_CODE' AND cc.common_code = 'DAILY_LOWER_ORG_TYPE' ) /* 하위 부서원 조회 가능한 조직 타입코드 */
ORDER BY org_id_path

WITH ORG_LIST AS ( SELECT /* LGVATT20010.retrieveOrgList */ org.organization_id , org.org_name , org.parent_org_id , org.org_type ,( SELECT xmlagg(XMLELEMENT(x, '/', om.organization_id) ORDER BY LEVEL DESC).extract('//text()').getstringval() FROM org_master om START WITH om.organization_id = org.organization_id AND trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN trunc(om.org_start_date) AND trunc(NVL(om.org_end_date, SYSDATE)) CONNECT BY PRIOR om.parent_org_id = om.organization_id AND trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN trunc(om.org_start_date) AND trunc(NVL(om.org_end_date, SYSDATE)) ) AS org_id_path /* 조직의 상하위 구조로 정렬하기 위해 조직의 상위조직을 역으로 조회하여 구성한다. */ FROM ( SELECT om.organization_id , om.org_name_local AS org_name , om.parent_org_id , LPAD(om.org_type, 3, '0') AS org_type FROM org_master om START WITH om.organization_id IN (SELECT om.organization_id FROM org_master om WHERE trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN trunc(om.org_start_date) AND trunc(NVL(om.org_end_date, SYSDATE)) AND om.org_manager_number = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.employeeNo} ) AND trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN trunc(om.org_start_date) AND trunc(NVL(om.org_end_date, SYSDATE)) CONNECT BY PRIOR om.organization_id = om.parent_org_id AND trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN trunc(om.org_start_date) AND trunc(NVL(om.org_end_date, SYSDATE)) UNION SELECT om.organization_id , om.org_name_local AS org_name , om.parent_org_id , LPAD(om.org_type, 3, '0') AS org_type FROM emp_master em , org_master om WHERE em.employee_number = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.employeeNo} AND om.organization_id = em.organization_id
UNION SELECT om.organization_id , om.org_name_local AS org_name , om.parent_org_id , LPAD(om.org_type, 3, '0') AS org_type FROM tb_att_contract_n tac , emp_master em , org_master om WHERE tac.time_attend_contact_user_id = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.employeeNo} AND em.assignment_category = 'LGD_OW' AND om.subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} AND om.subsidiary_code = em.subsidiary_code AND om.organization_id = em.organization_id AND om.organization_id = tac.organization_id AND om.subsidiary_code = tac.subsidiary_code
) org
WHERE org.org_type <= (SELECT code_data1_value FROM lgcom_common_code_c cc WHERE cc.code_type_code = 'LGVHR_ATT_COMMON_CODE' AND cc.common_code = 'DAILY_LOWER_ORG_TYPE' ) /* 하위 부서원 조회 가능한 조직 타입코드 */
ORDER BY org_id_path ) SELECT /* LGVATT20010.retrieveOrgEmployeeList */ em.employee_number AS code , em.full_name_local || ' ' || (SELECT lgvhr_common_pkg.decode_lookup(cc.code_type_code, cc.common_code, NULL, #{USER_SESSION.languageCode}) FROM DUAL) AS name , em.grade_title , org.organization_id AS p_code FROM emp_master em , org_list org , lgcom_common_code_c cc WHERE subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} AND em.organization_id = org.organization_id AND em.assignment_category = 'LGD_OW' /* 사무직 부서원만 조회 */ AND em.fse_yn = 'N' /* FSE 제외 */ AND em.flsa_yn = 'N' /* 단기파견자 제외 */
AND (em.date_retire IS NULL OR em.date_retire >= TRUNC(sysdate)) /* 재직자만 */
AND em.employee_number = #{checkEmployeeNo}
AND cc.code_type_code(+) = 'IF_VIETNAM_GRADE_TITLE' AND cc.common_code(+) = em.grade_title ORDER BY NVL(cc.sort_order_no, 10000), em.full_name_local

SELECT /* LGVATT20010.retrieveAttendanceDateList */ aca.time_and_attendance_yyyymm AS attendance_yyyymm , TO_CHAR(aca.time_and_attendance_date, 'DDMMYYYY') AS attendance_yyyymmdd , TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(aca.time_and_attendance_date, 'DD')) AS attendance_day , DECODE(MAX(aca.time_and_attendance_date) OVER (PARTITION BY 1), aca.time_and_attendance_date, 'Y', NULL) AS last_day_flag /* 마지막날인지 체크 */ , TO_CHAR(aca.time_and_attendance_date, 'D') AS week_day , aca.a_day_of_the_week_code AS week_name , aca.holiday_code , aca.holiday_flag FROM tb_att_close_n acl , tb_att_calendar_n aca WHERE acl.subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} AND acl.time_and_attendance_yyyymm = #{attendanceYyyymm} AND aca.subsidiary_code = acl.subsidiary_code AND aca.time_and_attendance_yyyymm = acl.time_and_attendance_yyyymm ORDER BY aca.time_and_attendance_date

SELECT /* LGVATT20010.retrieveAttendancePlanNResultList */ TO_CHAR(ap.time_and_attendance_date, 'DDMMYYYY') AS attendance_yyyymmdd /* 근태일 */ , ap.time_and_attendance_code AS att_code_plan /* 근태코드(계획) */ , ar.time_and_attendance_code AS att_code_rslt /* 근태코드(실적) */ , ac_p.time_and_attendance_short_name AS att_name_plan /* 근태명(계획) */ , ac_r.time_and_attendance_short_name AS att_name_rslt /* 근태명(실적) */ , lgvatt_common_pkg.get_work_hours(ap.subsidiary_code, ap.employee_no, ap.time_and_attendance_date) AS work_hours_plan /* 근무시간수(계획) */ , NVL(ar.work_hours, 0) - (NVL(ar.tardy_hours, 0) + NVL(ar.early_leave_hours, 0) + NVL(ar.going_out_hours, 0)) AS work_hours_rslt /* 근무시간수(실적) */ /* 2018.01.31 박귀희 : Deduction 항목 차감 */ , ap.overtime_sum_hours AS overtime_sum_hours_plan /* 연장근무합계시간수(계획) */ , ar.overtime_sum_hours AS overtime_sum_hours_rslt /* 연장근무합계시간수(실적) */ ,lgvatt_ot_calculation_pkg.get_ot_total(ap.subsidiary_code,ap.employee_no, ap.time_and_attendance_date, ap.time_and_attendance_date,'special_ot_n') AS special_ot_n /*HMT_20211018 special ot not confirm*/ ,lgvatt_ot_calculation_pkg.get_ot_total(ap.subsidiary_code,ap.employee_no, ap.time_and_attendance_date, ap.time_and_attendance_date,'special_ot_y') AS special_ot_y /*HMT_20211018 special ot confirm*/ ,(SELECT DECODE(MAX(lasn.approval_status_code) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY lasn.approval_seqs), '3', 'Y', 'N') /* 결재자 결재완료(3)이면 Y, 결재미완료이면 N, 결재자가 없는 경우 NULL */ FROM lgcom_approval_request_n larn , lgcom_approval_status_n lasn WHERE larn.request_master_id = ap.approval_request_id AND larn.request_code = ap.request_code AND lasn.request_master_id = larn.request_master_id AND lasn.request_code = larn.request_code AND lasn.approval_action_code = 'APPROVAL' GROUP BY larn.request_master_id, larn.request_code HAVING COUNT(lasn.user_no) > 1 AND MIN(lasn.approval_seqs) = 1 /* 결재자가 1명 이상인 요청서의 1차 결재자 */ ) AS "1st_approval_status_plan" /* 1차결재상태(계획) */ ,(SELECT DECODE(MAX(lasn.approval_status_code) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY lasn.approval_seqs), '3', 'Y', 'N') /* 결재자 결재완료(3)이면 Y, 결재미완료이면 N, 결재자가 없는 경우 NULL */ FROM lgcom_approval_request_n larn , lgcom_approval_status_n lasn WHERE larn.request_master_id = ar.approval_request_id AND larn.request_code = ar.request_code AND lasn.request_master_id = larn.request_master_id AND lasn.request_code = larn.request_code AND lasn.approval_action_code = 'APPROVAL' GROUP BY larn.request_master_id, larn.request_code HAVING COUNT(lasn.user_no) > 1 AND MIN(lasn.approval_seqs) = 1 /* 결재자가 1명 이상인 요청서의 1차 결재자 */ ) AS "1st_approval_status_rslt" /* 1차결재상태(실적) */ ,(SELECT DECODE(MAX(lasn.approval_status_code) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY lasn.approval_seqs), '3', 'Y', 'N') /* 결재자 결재완료(3)이면 Y, 결재미완료이면 N, 결재자가 없는 경우 NULL */ FROM lgcom_approval_request_n larn , lgcom_approval_status_n lasn WHERE larn.request_master_id = ap.approval_request_id AND larn.request_code = ap.request_code AND lasn.request_master_id = larn.request_master_id AND lasn.request_code = larn.request_code AND lasn.approval_action_code = 'APPROVAL' GROUP BY larn.request_master_id, larn.request_code HAVING COUNT(lasn.user_no) = MAX(lasn.approval_seqs) /* 최종 결재자 */ ) AS final_approval_status_plan /* 최종결재상태(계획) */ ,(SELECT DECODE(MAX(lasn.approval_status_code) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY lasn.approval_seqs), '3', 'Y', 'N') /* 결재자 결재완료이면 Y, 결재미완료이면 N, 결재자가 없는 경우 NULL */ FROM lgcom_approval_request_n larn , lgcom_approval_status_n lasn WHERE larn.request_master_id = ar.approval_request_id AND larn.request_code = ar.request_code AND lasn.request_master_id = larn.request_master_id AND lasn.request_code = larn.request_code AND lasn.approval_action_code = 'APPROVAL' GROUP BY larn.request_master_id, larn.request_code HAVING COUNT(lasn.user_no) = MAX(lasn.approval_seqs) /* 최종 결재자 */ ) AS final_approval_status_rslt /* 최종결재상태(실적) */
FROM tb_att_plan_n ap /* 계획근태 */ , tb_att_result_n ar /* 실적근태 */ , tb_att_code_c ac_p /* 근태코드(계획) */ , tb_att_code_c ac_r /* 근태코드(실적) */ WHERE ap.subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} AND ap.time_and_attendance_yyyymm = #{attendanceYyyymm} AND ap.employee_no = #{employeeNo} AND ar.subsidiary_code(+) = ap.subsidiary_code AND ar.employee_no(+) = ap.employee_no AND ar.time_and_attendance_date(+) = ap.time_and_attendance_date AND ac_p.subsidiary_code = ap.subsidiary_code AND ac_p.time_and_attendance_code = ap.time_and_attendance_code AND ac_r.subsidiary_code(+) = ar.subsidiary_code AND ac_r.time_and_attendance_code(+) = ar.time_and_attendance_code ORDER BY ap.time_and_attendance_date

SELECT /* LGVATT20010.retrieveMonthlyAttendanceSummaryData */ rs.employee_no , rs.time_and_attendance_yyyymm , TO_CHAR(rs.working_time_hours , 'FM9990.0') AS working_time_hours /* normal time */ , TO_CHAR(rs.night_hours , 'FM9990.0') AS night_hours /* night time */ , TO_CHAR(rs.overtime_hours , 'FM9990.0') AS overtime_hours /* overtime */ , TO_CHAR(rs.night_overtime_hours, 'FM9990.0') AS night_overtime_hours /* overtime at night */ , TO_CHAR(rs.paid_vacation_days , 'FM9990.0' ) AS paid_vacation_days /* paid leave */ , TO_CHAR(rs.absence_days , 'FM9990.0' ) AS absence_days /* absence */ , TO_CHAR(rs.tardy_hours , 'FM9990.0') AS tardy_hours /* lateness */ , TO_CHAR(rs.going_out_hours , 'FM9990.0') AS going_out_hours /* going out */ , TO_CHAR(rs.early_leave_hours , 'FM9990.0') AS early_leave_hours /* leaving early */ , TO_CHAR(rs.unpaid_vacation_days, 'FM9990.0' ) AS unpaid_vacation_days /* unpaid leave */ , TO_CHAR(rs.absence_leave_days , 'FM9990.0' ) AS absence_leave_days /* suspension */ , TO_CHAR(lgvatt_ot_calculation_pkg.get_ot_total(#{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode},rs.employee_no, to_date(rs.time_and_attendance_yyyymm, 'YYYYMM'), LAST_DAY(to_date(rs.time_and_attendance_yyyymm, 'YYYYMM')),'year_total_ot_result'), 'FM9990.0') AS year_ot /* HMT_20211018 */
, TO_CHAR(NVL(prev.residual_annual_leave_days, 0) + NVL(curr.curr_month_accu_creation_days, 0), 'FM9990.0') AS total_creation_days -- 총생성 (Total Annual Leave of This year) , TO_CHAR(NVL(prev.residual_annual_leave_days, 0), 'FM9990.0') AS prev_year_carr_fwd_days -- 전년이월 (Accumulation from Last Year) , TO_CHAR(NVL(curr.curr_month_accu_creation_days, 0), 'FM9990.0') AS curr_year_accu_creation_days -- 당년누적생성 (Create at This Year) , TO_CHAR(NVL(curr.curr_month_use_days, 0), 'FM9990.0') AS curr_month_use_days -- 당월사용 (Used Annual Leave at This Month) , TO_CHAR(NVL(curr.total_residual_days, 0), 'FM9990.0') AS total_residual_days -- 총잔여 (Remained Annual Leave of This Year) , TO_CHAR(GREATEST(0, NVL(prev.residual_annual_leave_days, 0) - NVL(curr.total_residual_days, 0)), 'FM9990.0') AS carr_fwd_residual_days -- 이월잔여 , TO_CHAR(NVL(curr.total_residual_days, 0) - GREATEST(0, NVL(prev.residual_annual_leave_days, 0) - NVL(curr.total_use_days, 0)), 'FM9990.0') AS curr_year_residual_days -- 당년잔여
FROM TABLE(CAST(lgvatt_common_pkg.get_att_result_monthly(#{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode}, #{employeeNo}, #{attendanceYyyymm}) AS lgvatt_result_monthly_tbl)) rs ,(SELECT #{employeeNo} AS employee_no , #{attendanceYyyymm} AS time_and_attendance_yyyymm -- 년월 , TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(MAX(time_and_attendance_yyyymm), 'YYYYMM'), -12), 'YYYY') || '12' AS prev_dec_yyyymm -- 전년12월 , NVL(SUM(NVL(occur_basic_annual_leave_days, 0) + NVL(occur_monthly_ann_lv_days, 0) + NVL(annual_calibration_days, 0)), 0) AS curr_month_accu_creation_days -- 당월누적 생성일수 , NVL(SUM(NVL(use_annual_leave_days, 0)), 0) AS total_use_days -- 총 사용일수 , NVL(MAX(DECODE(time_and_attendance_yyyymm, #{attendanceYyyymm}, use_annual_leave_days, 0)), 0) AS curr_month_use_days -- 당월 사용일수 , NVL(MAX(DECODE(time_and_attendance_yyyymm, #{attendanceYyyymm}, residual_annual_leave_days, 0)), 0) AS total_residual_days -- 총 남은일수 FROM tb_att_annual_leave_n WHERE subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} AND employee_no = #{employeeNo} AND time_and_attendance_yyyymm BETWEEN SUBSTR(#{attendanceYyyymm}, 1, 4) || '01' AND #{attendanceYyyymm} ) curr , tb_att_annual_leave_n prev
WHERE rs.employee_no = curr.employee_no(+) AND rs.time_and_attendance_yyyymm = curr.time_and_attendance_yyyymm(+) AND curr.employee_no = prev.employee_no(+) AND curr.prev_dec_yyyymm = prev.time_and_attendance_yyyymm(+)

SELECT /* LGVATT20010.retireveDirectOpenData */ CASE WHEN count(ar.employee_no) > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS popup_open_flag /* 사무직 일근태 입력 팝업 오픈 여부 */
FROM tb_att_result_n ar /* 실적근태 */ , TABLE(CAST(lgvatt_common_pkg.get_input_date(#{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode}, TRUNC(SYSDATE), 'RESULT') AS lgvatt_input_date_tbl)) dt /* 입력일에 따른 입력가능 일자 조회 */ , emp_master em WHERE ar.subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} AND ar.employee_no = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.employeeNo} AND dt.time_and_attendance_date = ar.time_and_attendance_date AND dt.inquery_enable_flag = 'Y' /* 조회가능한 날짜만 조회 */
/* 근태실적 입력 가능 일 중 실적 미입력된 건이 있는지 체크 */ AND dt.input_enable_flag = 'Y' /* 입력가능일 */ AND ar.approval_request_id IS NULL AND ar.request_code IS NULL AND ar.base_time_attend_apply_flag = 'Y' /* 기본근태 */ AND em.subsidiary_code = ar.subsidiary_code AND em.employee_number = ar.employee_no AND NVL(em.fse_yn, 'N') = 'N' AND NVL(em.flsa_yn, 'N') = 'N' AND em.assignment_category = 'LGD_OW' /* 사무직만 */ AND (em.date_retire IS NULL OR em.date_retire >= TRUNC(sysdate)) /* 재직자만 */ AND NVL(#{container}, 'N') = 'Y' AND NVL(#{letsFg}, 'N') = 'Y' /* Let's에서 직접호출된 경우 */
AND SYSDATE < (SELECT lgvatt_common_pkg.get_att_close_time(#{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode}, 'INPUT', SYSDATE, NVL(#{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.shiftTypeCode}, '1A')) AS limit_date FROM DUAL) /* 근태 입력 가능 시간까지만 띄우도록 */
